changes.title: No landing clearance
items: Your blink and anything that throws you no longer stop short of or nudge you away from trees, rocks, soundsystems, speakers or the treehouse: you land where you're sent, and only lakes stop you

changes.title: Treetop sigils
items: From the treetops, your placed sigils now show clearly above the trees in their full colour, each with a visible column of light down to its spot

changes.title: Edge fade
items: The grass at the edge of her light no longer shimmers as she walks: its fade stays put on each tuft
On a slower machine, far trees and decor fade out and back in gently instead of popping when the frame rate dips
String lights at the far edge go out bulb by bulb, not a whole string at once

changes.title: Soundsystem 150
items: Soundsystems and home's speakers have much less health (150 each, from 500), so a siege you're losing is over quickly instead of dragging on

changes.title: Wardrobe more
items: The wardrobe has a None for her jacket and for her top, and three tops to choose from: a T-shirt, a vest and a crop top
The shoe rack has new trousers (none, jeans, breeches, shorts, a miniskirt and a long skirt) and new shoes (none, high heels and boots)
The bag station's cards show each bag without its strap
A change of outfit shows on her much sooner

changes.title: Her magic glows
items: Your own magic glows like the creatures' spells: the party start's bars at the decks, your blink and the ley line's spark each get a bright core, a pixel halo and a pool of light on the ground, and light the forest around them
A pool of light follows you on the ground as you fly, in your trail's colour; Reduce flashing halves the glow
